title: R2VではなくI2V（ファーストフレームとラストフレームの2枚参照）で生成を試すと、アニメキャラ→実写版の変換ダンス動画を成立させやすい

tips: R2VではなくI2V（ファーストフレームとラストフレームの2枚参照）で生成を試すと、アニメキャラ→実写版の変換ダンス動画を成立させやすい

en.content:
If you try generating with I2V instead of R2V (using two reference images: the first frame and the last frame), it’s easier to create a transformation dance video from an anime character to a live-action version.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
#AIart  #seedance
I tried using Seedance2.5 to see whether it could produce a dance video featuring an anime character and its live-action version 😆
As you can see from the result 😅
Even Seedance2.5 struggles!
It’s a failure, but please enjoy the current limits and the mysterious transformation dance 😀
via @get_artcraft https://t.co/KcFRCRTXDu
